title: Three particles B, C, C on an equilateral triangle of side 5, at rest, T = 2: pairwise sum with P-0005 coefficients (C-C in N = 3)

claims.statement: Three particles at rest on an equilateral triangle of side 5 with species B, C, C, T = 2: the pairwise sum over partners of the P-0005 sep-5 coefficients, with no three-body term, reproduces the tracker positions at tracker-noise level. Residual rms 0.047 (2026-11-19/r2/lab-a/001) and 0.050 (2026-11-19/r3/lab-a/002) per coordinate; the zero-force null is 0.14. No census events; labels constant. Domain is the one tested: side 5 only.
